001_init.sql: create extension if not exists pg_trgm

create table if not exists public.app_roles (
  user_id    uuid primary key references neon_auth."user"(id) on delete cascade,
  role       text not null check (role in ('editor','admin')),
  granted_by text not null,                      -- who granted it (trusted admin process)
  granted_at timestamptz not null default now()
)

create or replace function public.app_role() returns text
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select coalesce((select role from public.app_roles where user_id = auth.uid()), 'user')
$$

create or replace function public.is_editor() returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select public.app_role() in ('editor','admin')
$$

create or replace function public.is_admin() returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select public.app_role() = 'admin'
$$

create or replace function public.touch_updated_at() returns trigger
language plpgsql as $$ begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end $$

create table if not exists public.audit_log (
  id         bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  actor_id   uuid,
  table_name text not null,
  row_id     text,
  action     text not null,
  old_data   jsonb,
  new_data   jsonb,
  at         timestamptz not null default now()
)

create or replace function public.audit_trigger() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare uid uuid;
begin
  begin uid := auth.uid(); exception when others then uid := null; end;
  insert into public.audit_log(actor_id, table_name, row_id, action, old_data, new_data)
  values (uid, tg_table_name,
          coalesce((case when tg_op='DELETE' then to_jsonb(old) else to_jsonb(new) end)->>'id',
                   (case when tg_op='DELETE' then to_jsonb(old) else to_jsonb(new) end)->>'user_id'),
          tg_op,
          case when tg_op in ('UPDATE','DELETE') then to_jsonb(old) end,
          case when tg_op in ('INSERT','UPDATE') then to_jsonb(new) end);
  return coalesce(new, old);
end $$

create table if not exists public.profiles (
  user_id      uuid primary key default auth.uid() references neon_auth."user"(id) on delete cascade,
  display_name text check (char_length(display_name) <= 80),
  affiliation  text check (affiliation in ('student','staff','visitor','other')),
  theme        text not null default 'system' check (theme in ('light','dark','system')),
  notify_announcements boolean not null default true,
  notify_categories    text[] not null default '{}',
  created_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz not null default now()
)
create trigger profiles_touch before update on public.profiles for each row execute function public.touch_updated_at()

create table if not exists public.location_categories (
  slug       text primary key,
  label      text not null,
  icon       text not null,          -- icon key used by the frontend
  sort_order int  not null default 100
)

create or replace function public.imm_join(text[]) returns text
language sql immutable parallel safe as $$ select array_to_string($1, ' ') $$

create table if not exists public.locations (
  id               uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name             text not null check (char_length(name) between 2 and 160),
  category         text not null references public.location_categories(slug),
  description      text,
  lat              double precision not null check (lat between 5.60 and 5.70),
  lng              double precision not null check (lng between -0.23 and -0.15),
  location_context text,
  alt_names        text[] not null default '{}',
  accessibility    text,                                -- only verified notes
  source_label     text not null,                       -- e.g. 'OpenStreetMap'
  source_url       text,
  source_ref       text unique,                         -- e.g. 'osm:way/123' for idempotent imports
  verification     text not null default 'unverified'
                   check (verification in ('verified','unverified','osm_imported')),
  last_verified_at timestamptz,
  is_published     boolean not null default true,
  search_doc       tsvector generated always as (
                     setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(name,'')), 'A') ||
                     setweight(to_tsvector('simple', public.imm_join(alt_names)), 'A') ||
                     setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(category,'')), 'B') ||
                     setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(description,'') || ' ' || coalesce(location_context,'')), 'C')
                   ) stored,
  created_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at       timestamptz not null default now()
)
create index if not exists locations_search_idx on public.locations using gin (search_doc)
create index if not exists locations_name_trgm on public.locations using gin (name gin_trgm_ops)
create index if not exists locations_category_idx on public.locations (category)
create trigger locations_touch before update on public.locations for each row execute function public.touch_updated_at()
create trigger locations_audit after insert or update or delete on public.locations for each row execute function public.audit_trigger()

create or replace function public.search_locations(q text, max_results int default 20)
returns setof public.locations
language sql stable as $$
  select l.* from public.locations l
  where l.is_published
    and char_length(trim(q)) >= 2
    and ( l.search_doc @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', q)
       or l.name ilike '%' || q || '%'
       or exists (select 1 from unnest(l.alt_names) a where a ilike '%' || q || '%')
       or similarity(l.name, q) > 0.25 )
  order by (l.name ilike q) desc,
           (l.name ilike q || '%') desc,
           ts_rank(l.search_doc, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', q)) desc,
           similarity(l.name, q) desc,
           (l.verification = 'verified') desc
  limit least(greatest(max_results, 1), 50)
$$

create table if not exists public.announcements (
  id            uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  title         text not null check (char_length(title) between 4 and 200),
  summary       text not null check (char_length(summary) <= 600),
  body          text,
  category      text not null check (category in
                  ('official','registration','orientation','accommodation','academic_calendar',
                   'student_services','disruption','industrial_action','deadline','other')),
  source_org    text not null,
  source_url    text,
  location_id   uuid references public.locations(id) on delete set null,
  status        text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft','pending','published','unpublished')),
  published_at  timestamptz,            -- when the SOURCE published it
  expires_at    timestamptz,
  created_by    uuid default auth.uid(),
  approved_by   uuid,
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at    timestamptz not null default now()
)
create index if not exists announcements_pub_idx on public.announcements (status, published_at desc)
create trigger announcements_touch before update on public.announcements for each row execute function public.touch_updated_at()

create trigger announcements_guard before insert or update on public.announcements

create table if not exists public.fresher_resources (

                      ('getting_started','registration','orientation','academic','facilities',

  title             text not null,
  body              text not null,
  is_official       boolean not null default false,   -- true only when backed by a UG source
  source_label      text,
  source_url        text,
  source_updated_at date,
  location_id       uuid references public.locations(id) on delete set null,
  contact_phone     text,
  contact_email     text,
  opening_hours     text,
  sort_order        int not null default 100,
  is_published      boolean not null default false,
  created_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  check (not is_official or source_url is not null)
)
create trigger fresher_touch before update on public.fresher_resources for each row execute function public.touch_updated_at()
create trigger fresher_audit after insert or update or delete on public.fresher_resources for each row execute function public.audit_trigger()

create trigger checklist_touch before update on public.checklist_items for each row execute function public.touch_updated_at()
create trigger checklist_audit after insert or update or delete on public.checklist_items for each row execute function public.audit_trigger()

create table if not exists public.checklist_progress (

create table if not exists public.reports (

create trigger reports_touch before update on public.reports for each row execute function public.touch_updated_at()

create table if not exists public.courses (
  id         uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id    uuid not null default auth.uid() references neon_auth."user"(id) on delete cascade,
  code       text not null check (char_length(code) between 2 and 20),
  title      text check (char_length(title) <= 160),
  lecturer   text check (char_length(lecturer) <= 120),
  credits    smallint check (credits between 0 and 30),
  color      text not null default '#2563eb' check (color ~ '^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$'),
  semester   text check (char_length(semester) <= 40),
  notes      text check (char_length(notes) <= 2000),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (user_id, code)
)

create table if not exists public.class_sessions (
  id          uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id     uuid not null default auth.uid() references neon_auth."user"(id) on delete cascade,
  course_id   uuid not null references public.courses(id) on delete cascade,
  kind        text not null default 'lecture' check (kind in ('lecture','tutorial','lab','seminar','exam','other')),
  weekday     smallint not null check (weekday between 1 and 7),           -- 1 = Monday
  starts_at   time not null,
  ends_at     time not null check (ends_at > starts_at),
  location_id uuid references public.locations(id) on delete set null,    -- venue from the campus directory
  venue_text  text check (char_length(venue_text) <= 120),                 -- or free text if not in the directory
  created_at  timestamptz not null default now()
)
create index if not exists class_sessions_user_day on public.class_sessions (user_id, weekday, starts_at)

  created_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz not null default now()
)

create or replace function public.admin_stats() returns json
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select case when public.is_editor() then json_build_object(
    'users', (select count(*) from neon_auth."user"), 'verified_users', (select count(*) from neon_auth."user" where "emailVerified"),

create or replace function public.search_rooms(q text, max_results int default 8)
returns table (id uuid, code text, name text, floor text, directions text, verification text, location_id uuid, building text)
language sql stable as $$
  select r.id, r.code, r.name, r.floor, r.directions, r.verification, r.location_id, l.name
  from public.rooms r join public.locations l on l.id = r.location_id
  where r.is_published and l.is_published and char_length(trim(q)) >= 2
    and (r.code ilike '%' || q || '%' or r.name ilike '%' || q || '%'
         or (l.name || ' ' || r.code) ilike '%' || q || '%'
         or exists (select 1 from unnest(l.alt_names) a where (a || ' ' || r.code) ilike '%' || q || '%')
         or similarity(r.code, q) > 0.3)
  order by (r.code ilike q) desc, similarity(r.code, q) desc, r.code
  limit least(greatest(max_results, 1), 30)
$$

create or replace function public.get_live_share(p_token text)
returns table (sharer_name text, dest_name text, dest_lat double precision, dest_lng double precision, lat double precision, lng double precision,
               accuracy real, heading real, eta_s int, status text, updated_at timestamptz, expires_at timestamptz)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select s.sharer_name, l.name, l.lat, l.lng, s.lat, s.lng, s.accuracy, s.heading, s.eta_s,
         case when s.expires_at < now() and s.status = 'active' then 'expired' else s.status end, s.updated_at, s.expires_at
  from public.live_shares s left join public.locations l on l.id = s.dest_location_id
  where s.token = p_token and char_length(p_token) = 32
$$

  ) end
$$

create or replace function public.admin_analytics(p_days int default 30)
returns json language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  with d as (select greatest(1, least(p_days, 365)) as nd),
  dev as (select * from public.device_daily, d where day > current_date - d.nd)
  select case when public.is_editor() then json_build_object(
    'users', json_build_object(
      'total', (select count(*) from neon_auth."user"),
      'verified', (select count(*) from neon_auth."user" where "emailVerified"),
      'new_in_period', (select count(*) from neon_auth."user", d where "createdAt" > now() - make_interval(days => d.nd)),
      'with_details', (select count(*) from public.profiles where programme is not null or level is not null),
      'push_devices', (select count(*) from public.push_subscriptions)),
    'active', json_build_object(
      'dau_devices', (select count(distinct device) from public.device_daily where day = current_date),
      'wau_devices', (select count(distinct device) from public.device_daily where day > current_date - 7),
      'mau_devices', (select count(distinct device) from public.device_daily where day > current_date - 30),
      'dau_users', (select count(distinct user_id) from public.device_daily where day = current_date and user_id is not null),
      'wau_users', (select count(distinct user_id) from public.device_daily where day > current_date - 7 and user_id is not null),
      'mau_users', (select count(distinct user_id) from public.device_daily where day > current_date - 30 and user_id is not null),
      'returning_devices', (select count(*) from (select device from dev group by device having count(*) >= 2) r),
      'devices_in_period', (select count(distinct device) from dev)),
    'daily', (select coalesce(json_agg(t order by t.day), '[]') from (
      select g.day::date as day,
        (select count(distinct device) from public.device_daily x where x.day = g.day) as devices,
        (select count(distinct user_id) from public.device_daily x where x.day = g.day and user_id is not null) as users,
        (select count(*) from neon_auth."user" u where u."createdAt"::date = g.day) as signups,
        (select coalesce(sum(n), 0) from public.usage_daily x where x.day = g.day and x.event = 'app_open') as opens
      from d, generate_series(current_date - d.nd + 1, current_date, interval '1 day') g(day)) t),
    'events', (select coalesce(json_object_agg(event, n), '{}') from (select event, sum(n)::int n from public.usage_daily, d where day > current_date - d.nd group by event) e),
    'platforms', (select coalesce(json_object_agg(platform, n), '{}') from (select platform, count(distinct device) n from dev group by platform) p),
    'installed_devices', (select count(distinct device) from dev where standalone),
    'hours', (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('hour', hour, 'n', n) order by hour), '[]') from (select hour, sum(n)::int n from public.usage_hourly, d where day > current_date - d.nd group by hour) h),
    'students', json_build_object(
      'by_type', (select coalesce(json_object_agg(t, n), '{}') from (select case when affiliation = 'student' and level = '100' then 'fresher' when affiliation = 'student' and level in ('200','300','400','500','600') then 'continuing' when affiliation = 'student' and level in ('masters','mphil','phd') then 'postgraduate' when affiliation = 'student' then 'student (level not set)' else coalesce(affiliation, 'not set') end t, count(*) n from public.profiles group by 1) x),
      'by_level', (select coalesce(json_object_agg(coalesce(level, 'not set'), n), '{}') from (select level, count(*) n from public.profiles group by level) x),
      'by_residence', (select coalesce(json_object_agg(coalesce(residence, 'not set'), n), '{}') from (select residence, count(*) n from public.profiles group by residence) x),
      'top_halls', (select coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]') from (select coalesce(l.name, p.hall_name) as name, count(*) n from public.profiles p left join public.locations l on l.id = p.hall_location_id where coalesce(l.name, p.hall_name) is not null group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 10) x),
      'top_programmes', (select coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]') from (select initcap(trim(programme)) as name, count(*) n from public.profiles where programme is not null group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 10) x)),
    'features', json_build_object(
      'users_with_timetable', (select count(distinct user_id) from public.courses),
      'class_sessions', (select count(*) from public.class_sessions),
      'users_with_exams', (select count(distinct user_id) from public.exams),
      'users_with_gpa', (select count(distinct user_id) from public.gpa_records),
      'saved_places', (select count(*) from public.saved_places),
      'live_shares', (select count(*) from public.live_shares, d where created_at > now() - make_interval(days => d.nd)),
      'reports_open', (select count(*) from public.reports where status = 'open')),
    'top_destinations', (select coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') from (select l.name, sum(u.n)::int n from public.usage_daily u join public.locations l on l.id::text = u.key, d where u.event = 'route' and u.day > current_date - d.nd group by l.name order by 2 desc limit 10) t),
    'top_viewed', (select coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') from (select l.name, sum(u.n)::int n from public.usage_daily u join public.locations l on l.id::text = u.key, d where u.event = 'place_view' and u.day > current_date - d.nd group by l.name order by 2 desc limit 10) t)
  ) end
$$
grant execute on function public.admin_analytics(int) to authenticated

create or replace function public.admin_users(p_q text default '', p_limit int default 200)
returns table (user_id uuid, email text, name text, joined timestamptz, verified boolean, last_active date, active_days int,
               affiliation text, level text, programme text, hall text, role text)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select u.id, u.email, coalesce(p.display_name, u.name), u."createdAt", u."emailVerified",
         (select max(day) from public.device_daily d where d.user_id = u.id),
         (select count(distinct day)::int from public.device_daily d where d.user_id = u.id),
         p.affiliation, p.level, p.programme, coalesce(l.name, p.hall_name), r.role
  from neon_auth."user" u
  left join public.profiles p on p.user_id = u.id
  left join public.locations l on l.id = p.hall_location_id
  left join public.app_roles r on r.user_id = u.id
  where public.is_admin() and (p_q = '' or u.email ilike '%' || p_q || '%' or coalesce(p.display_name, u.name, '') ilike '%' || p_q || '%')
  order by u."createdAt" desc
  limit least(greatest(p_limit, 1), 1000)
$$
grant execute on function public.admin_users(text, int) to authenticated
